name: kotlin-coding-practices
description: Coroutine-first and immutable-by-default Kotlin coding practices.

interface.longDescription: Guides Kotlin and Android Kotlin development toward structured concurrency, suspending APIs, coroutine-friendly synchronization, immutable values, and explicit boundaries around platform APIs that require Java threading or blocking behavior.
defaultPrompt: Review this Kotlin code for coroutine and blocking issues.
Refactor this Kotlin flow to structured concurrency.
Reduce mutable state in this Kotlin implementation.
